title: TRELLIS.2: High-Fidelity 3D Generation on Mac
summary: A 4B parameter foundation model for generating detailed 3D assets with PBR materials from images or text. It utilizes Omni-Voxel representation to handle arbitrary topologies and complex surface geometry.
research_notes: The shivampkumar/trellis-mac repository ports the model to Apple Silicon using the MPS backend, though some CUDA-specific features like texture baking are limited.

evolution.summary: TRELLIS.2 succeeded the original 2B parameter version, introducing Omni-Voxels (O-Voxels) and full Physically Based Rendering (PBR) support. It expanded resolution capabilities and improved geometric accuracy for non-manifold surfaces.
